name: Mount Moran
note: Synthetic scenario. Same DEM for the hidden demo spot and the model, so real-world DEM and sensor error are not included.
frame: x = (lon - west) * m_per_deg[0] metres east, y = (lat - south) * m_per_deg[1] metres north; cell (row, col) centre at x = (col + 0.5) * cell_m[0], y = (rows - row - 0.5) * cell_m[1]; row 0 is north

elevation.meaning: ground height m = offset + value * scale, 6 x 6 mean of the 5 m grid

water.meaning: 1 = water (majority of the 5 m water mask)

slope.meaning: slope deg = value * scale, 30 m grid

visibility.meaning: bit k set = peaks[k] summit in line of sight from the cell (eye 1.7 m, curvature, k 0.13)

peak_criteria.dem: 5 m texture grid of the tile
peak_criteria.extra: tops within 150 m of the tile edge dropped; named from terrain_meta peaks within 250 m

demo.note: Synthetic demo spot for the RIDGELINE live solve. Made up, not a real person or position. Hidden on the judge map until Reveal.

saved_points.note: Synthetic destinations saved on the phone for the demo, not real people or positions.
